description: Record what the USER decided about an action you consulted Phaedo on: approved | rejected | modified | unknown. Call it when the user reacts to that action — they confirm it (approved), refuse or undo it (rejected), or want it done differently (modified). Always pass the receipt_id that phaedo_consult (or a Phaedo hook) gave you; without it the most recent receipt is marked, which may be a different action. Record what the user chose, never whether you proceeded: silence is not approval, and an approval you inferred teaches nothing. A rejected/modified outcome teaches Phaedo how the user wants delegated work handled (the act-as-me channel).
name: phaedo_record_outcome
title: Record what the subject decided about a consulted action
